gloss: best time to see; peak viewing season

definitions.gloss: best time to see; peak viewing season; in full bloom/color
definitions.explanation: The optimal time to view something, especially flowers, autumn leaves, or other natural scenery at their most beautiful.

examples.japanese: {桜|さくら}が{見頃|みごろ}を{迎|むか}えた。
examples.english: The cherry blossoms have reached their peak.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|こうよう}の{見頃|みごろ}は{十一月|じゅういちがつ}{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}ごろだ。
examples.english: The best time to see autumn leaves is around mid-November.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{暖冬|だんとう}だったので、{梅|うめ}の{見頃|みごろ}が{例年|れいねん}より{早|はや}かった。
examples.english: This year was a mild winter, so the peak plum blossom season came earlier than usual.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used for cherry blossoms ({桜|さくら}), autumn leaves ({紅葉|こうよう}), and other seasonal flowers. A key word in Japanese seasonal culture and tourism. Often seen in weather forecasts and travel guides.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見頃|みごろ}を{迎|むか}える (to reach peak viewing time)
- {桜|さくら}の{見頃|みごろ} (peak cherry blossom season)
- {紅葉|こうよう}の{見頃|みごろ} (peak autumn foliage season)
- {見頃|みごろ}{情報|じょうほう} (viewing season information)
